summary: Cred and Duck discuss the crypto market in February 2023 with overall bullish sentiment, particularly on Bitcoin which they expect to continue to 30-32k from current levels above 20k. They discuss resistance levels for BTC at 24.3k and ETH at 1680, while Duck remains bullish on LTC expecting it to break $100 and potentially double.
